program two_contests
  implicit none
  integer :: n, a(0:100001,2) = 0, pre(0:100001) = 0, suf(0:100001) = 0, i, x = 0
  read(*,*) n
  do i = 1, n
    read(*,*) a(i,1:2)
  end do
  call merge_sort(a(1:n,1:2))
  pre(0) = 1e9
  suf(n+1) = 1e9
  do i = 1, n
    pre(i) = min(pre(i-1),a(i,2))
  end do
  do i = n, 1, -1
    suf(i) = min(suf(i+1),a(i,2))
  end do
  do i = 1, n-1
    x = max(x,max(calc(a(i,1),pre(i))+calc(a(n,1),suf(i+1)),calc(a(i,1),a(i,2))+calc(a(n,1),min(pre(i-1),suf(i+1)))))
  end do
  write(*,'(i0)') x
contains
  integer function calc(l,r)
    integer, intent(in) :: l, r
    calc = r-l+1
    if (l > r) calc = 0
  end
  subroutine merge_sort(a)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a(:,:)
    integer :: n, m, l, i, u
    n = size(a,1)
    m = n
    l = 1
    do while (m > 1)
      do i = 1, m/2
        u = min(2*i*l,n)
        call merger(a(2*(i-1)*l+1:(2*i-1)*l,:),a((2*i-1)*l+1:u,:))
      end do
      l = 2*l
      m = (m+1)/2
    end do
  end
  subroutine merger(a1,a2)
    integer, intent(inout) :: a1(:,:), a2(:,:)
    integer :: a(size(a1,1)+size(a2,1),size(a1,2))
    integer :: i1, i2, n1, n2
    i1 = 1
    i2 = 1
    n1 = size(a1,1)
    n2 = size(a2,1)
    do while (i1 <= n1 .and. i2 <= n2)
      if (a1(i1,1) < a2(i2,1) .or. &
      & (a1(i1,1) == a2(i2,1) .and. a1(i1,2) <= a2(i2,2))) then
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a1(i1,:)
        i1 = i1+1
      else
        a(i1+i2-1,:) = a2(i2,:)
        i2 = i2+1
       end if
    end do
    if (i1 <= n1) then
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a1(i1:n1,:)
    else
      a(i1+i2-1:n1+n2,:) = a2(i2:n2,:)
    end if
    a1 = a(1:n1,:)
    a2 = a(n1+1:n1+n2,:)
  end
end program two_contests

local mfl, mce, mmi = math.floor, math.ceil, math.min
local SegTree = {}
SegTree.updateAll = function(self)
  for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
    for j = 1, self.cnt[i] do
      self.stage[i][j] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][j * 2 - 1], self.stage[i + 1][j * 2])
    end
  end
end
SegTree.create = function(self, n, func, emptyvalue)
  self.func, self.emptyvalue = func, emptyvalue
  local stagenum, mul = 1, 1
  self.cnt, self.stage, self.size = {1}, {{}}, {}
  while mul < n do
    mul, stagenum = mul * 2, stagenum + 1
    self.cnt[stagenum], self.stage[stagenum] = mul, {}
  end
  for i = 1, stagenum do self.size[i] = self.cnt[stagenum + 1 - i] end
  self.stagenum = stagenum
  -- for i = 1, #ary do self.stage[stagenum][i] = ary[i] end
  -- for i = #ary + 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  for i = 1, mul do self.stage[stagenum][i] = emptyvalue end
  self:updateAll()
end
SegTree.getRange = function(self, left, right)
  if left == right then return self.stage[self.stagenum][left] end
  local start_stage = 1
  while right - left + 1 < self.size[start_stage] do
    start_stage = start_stage + 1
  end
  local ret = self.emptyvalue
  local t1, t2, t3 = {start_stage}, {left}, {right}
  while 0 < #t1 do
    local stage, l, r = t1[#t1], t2[#t1], t3[#t1]
    table.remove(t1) table.remove(t2) table.remove(t3)
    local sz = self.size[stage]
    if (l - 1) % sz ~= 0 then
      local newr = mmi(r, mce((l - 1) / sz) * sz)
      table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, newr)
      l = newr + 1
    end
    if sz <= r + 1 - l then
      ret = self.func(ret, self.stage[stage][mce(l / sz)])
      l = l + sz
    end
    if l <= r then
      table.insert(t1, stage + 1) table.insert(t2, l) table.insert(t3, r)
    end
  end
  return ret
end
SegTree.setValue = function(self, idx, value, silent)
  self.stage[self.stagenum][idx] = value
  if not silent then
    for i = self.stagenum - 1, 1, -1 do
      local dst = mce(idx / 2)
      local rem = dst * 4 - 1 - idx
      self.stage[i][dst] = self.func(self.stage[i + 1][idx], self.stage[i + 1][rem])
      idx = dst
    end
  end
end
SegTree.new = function(n, func, emptyvalue)
  local obj = {}
  setmetatable(obj, {__index = SegTree})
  obj:create(n, func, emptyvalue)
  return obj
end

        tmpscore = ts2

          tmpscore = ts2
        end
      end
    end

      where

                           | g lr1 - g lr1' < g lr0 - g lr0' = (lr0, lr1')
                           | g lr0' < g lr1' = (lr0, lr1')

                          | otherwise = h p lrs

-- query :: Int -> VU.Vector (Int,Int) -> (Int,Int)
query n probsImmut = oneTake `max` sepVal
  where
    probs = VU.create $ do
      probs <- VU.unsafeThaw probsImmut
      vait_sortBy (compare `on` first Down) probs
      return probs
    !lMax = fst $ probs VU.! 0
    !lMax1 = fst $ probs VU.! 1
    (!rMin,!rMin1)
      = VU.foldl' (\(!rMin,!rMin1) v ->
                     if | v < rMin -> (v,rMin)
                        | v < rMin1 -> (rMin,v)
                        | otherwise -> (rMin,rMin1))
              (maxBound,maxBound) $ VU.map snd probs
    oneTake = VU.maximum
      $ (`VU.map` probs)
      $ \(l,r) ->
          ((r - l + 1)+)
          $ max 0 $ 1 + (if r == rMin then rMin1 else rMin)
                      - (if l == lMax then lMax1 else lMax)
    probsRemoved = VU.map fst $ VU.filter snd $ VU.postscanl'
      (\((!x,!y),!b) (!u,!v) -> if y <= v then ((x,y),False) else ((u,v),True))
      ((maxBound,maxBound),False) probs
    sepVal
      | VU.length probsRemoved <= 1 = 0
      | otherwise =
        VU.maximum
        $ VU.zipWith (\l r -> max 0 (r-l0+1) + max 0 (r0-l+1)) (VU.tail ls) rs
      where (ls,rs) = VU.unzip probsRemoved
            (l0,_) = VU.head probsRemoved
            (_,r0) = VU.last probsRemoved

-- | Sorts an entire array using the default ordering.
vait_sort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e, Ord e)
  => v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sort = vait_sortBy compare
{-# INLINABLE vait_sort #-}

-- | Sorts an entire array using a custom ordering.
vait_sortBy :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> m ()
vait_sortBy cmp a = vait_sortByBounds cmp a 0 (VGM.length a)
{-# INLINE vait_sortBy #-}

-- | Sorts a portion of an array [l,u) using a custom ordering
vait_sortByBounds
  :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e
  -> Int -- ^ lower index, l
  -> Int -- ^ upper index, u
  -> m ()
vait_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vait_introsort cmp a (vait_ilg len) l u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vait_sortByBounds #-}

-- Internal version of the introsort loop which allows partial
-- sort functions to call with a specified bound on iterations.
vait_introsort :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
   => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vait_introsort cmp a i l u = sort i l u >> vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 where
 sort 0 l u = vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u
 sort d l u
   | len < vait_threshold = return ()
   | otherwise = do
       vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a c l (u-1)
        -- sort the median into the lowest position
       p <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       mid <- vait_partitionBy cmp a p (l+1) u
       VGM.unsafeSwap a l (mid - 1)
       sort (d-1) mid u
       sort (d-1) l   (mid - 1)
  where
    len = u - l
    c   = vac_midPoint u l
{-# INLINE vait_introsort #-}

vait_partitionBy :: forall m v e. (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
vait_partitionBy cmp a = partUp
 where
 partUp :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partUp p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
       case cmp e p of
         LT -> partUp p (l+1) u
         _  -> partDown p l (u-1)
   | otherwise = return l

 partDown :: e -> Int -> Int -> m Int
 partDown p l u
   | l < u = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a u
       case cmp p e of
         LT -> partDown p l (u-1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeSwap a l u >> partUp p (l+1) u
   | otherwise = return l
{-# INLINE vait_partitionBy #-}

vait_ilg :: Int -> Int
vait_ilg !m = 2 * (finiteBitSize m - countLeadingZeros m - 1)

vait_threshold = 18

vah_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vah_heapify cmp a l u >> vah_sortHeap cmp a l (l+4) u
    >> vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vah_sortByBounds #-}

vah_heapify :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_heapify cmp a l u = loop $ (len - 1) `shiftR` 2
  where
 len = u - l
 loop k
   | k < 0     = return ()
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeRead a (l+k) >>= \e ->
                   vah_siftByOffset cmp a e l k len >> loop (k - 1)
{-# INLINE vah_heapify #-}

vah_pop :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_pop cmp a l u = vah_popTo cmp a l u u
{-# INLINE vah_pop #-}

vah_popTo :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_popTo cmp a l u t = do
  al <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  at <- VGM.unsafeRead a t
  VGM.unsafeWrite a t al
  vah_siftByOffset cmp a at l 0 (u - l)
{-# INLINE vah_popTo #-}

vah_sortHeap :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_sortHeap cmp a l m u = loop (u-1) >> VGM.unsafeSwap a l m
 where
 loop k
   | m < k     = vah_pop cmp a l k >> loop (k-1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vah_sortHeap #-}

vah_heapInsert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e) => Comparison e
  -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> e -> m ()
vah_heapInsert cmp v l u e = sift (u - l)
 where
 sift k
   | k <= 0    = VGM.unsafeWrite v l e
   | otherwise = let pi = l + shiftR (k-1) 2
                  in VGM.unsafeRead v pi >>= \p -> case cmp p e of
                       LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) p >> sift pi
                       _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite v (l + k) e
{-# INLINE vah_heapInsert #-}

vah_siftByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vah_siftByOffset cmp a val off start len = sift val start len
 where
 sift val root len
   | child < len = do
       (child', ac) <- vah_maximumChild cmp a off child len
       case cmp val ac of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) ac
               >> sift val child' len
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
   | otherwise = VGM.unsafeWrite a (root + off) val
  where child = root `shiftL` 2 + 1
{-# INLINE vah_siftByOffset #-}

vah_maximumChild :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m (Int,  e)
vah_maximumChild cmp a off child1 len
  | child4 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      ac4 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child4 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac2 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> case cmp ac3 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> case cmp ac1 ac4 of
            LT -> (child4, ac4)
            _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child3 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      ac3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child3 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> case cmp ac2 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> case cmp ac1 ac3 of
          LT -> (child3, ac3)
          _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | child2 < len = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off)
      ac2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child2 + off)
      return $ case cmp ac1 ac2 of
        LT -> (child2, ac2)
        _  -> (child1, ac1)
  | otherwise    = do
      ac1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a (child1 + off); return (child1, ac1)
 where
 child2 = child1 + 1
 child3 = child1 + 2
 child4 = child1 + 3
{-# INLINE vah_maximumChild #-}

vais_sortByBounds :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds cmp a l u FILTERED
  = vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a l >> vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l (l + 4) u
 where len = u - l
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds #-}

vais_sortByBounds' :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vais_sortByBounds' cmp a l m u = sort m
 where
 sort i
   | i < u     = do
       v <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
       vais_insert cmp a l v i
       sort (i+1)
   | otherwise = return ()
{-# INLINE vais_sortByBounds' #-}

vais_insert :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> e -> Int -> m ()
vais_insert cmp a l = loop
 where
 loop val j
   | j <= l    = VGM.unsafeWrite a l val
   | otherwise = do
       e <- VGM.unsafeRead a (j - 1)
       case cmp val e of
         LT -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j e >> loop val (j - 1)
         _  -> VGM.unsafeWrite a j val
{-# INLINE vais_insert #-}

#define vec_writes2(a,v,w)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> VGM.unsafeWrite a w)
#define vec_writes3(a,v,w,x)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes2(a,w,x))
#define vec_writes4(a,v,w,x,y)\
  (VGM.unsafeWrite a v >> vec_writes3(a,w,x,y))

vao_sort2ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByOffset #-}

vao_sort2ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort2ByIndex cmp a i j = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0)
    _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort2ByIndex #-}

vao_sort3ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByOffset cmp a off = vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByOffset #-}

vao_sort3ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort3ByIndex cmp a i j k = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a2 a1 of
        LT -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0)
        _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0)
      _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1)
        _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1)
      _  -> return ()
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort3ByIndex #-}

vao_sort4ByOffset :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByOffset cmp a off
  = vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a off (off + 1) (off + 2) (off + 3)
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByOffset #-}

vao_sort4ByIndex :: (PrimMonad m, VGM.MVector v e)
  => Comparison e -> v (PrimState m) e -> Int -> Int -> Int -> Int -> m ()
vao_sort4ByIndex cmp a i j k l = do
  a0 <- VGM.unsafeRead a i
  a1 <- VGM.unsafeRead a j
  a2 <- VGM.unsafeRead a k
  a3 <- VGM.unsafeRead a l
  case cmp a0 a1 of
    GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a1 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a1,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a1,l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a2,{-j a1-}k a0{-l a3-})
        _ -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes2(a,i a3,{-j a1;k a2-}l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a3,{-k a2-}l a0)
          _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a2,k a3,l a0)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a1,j a2,k a0{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a0 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a1 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,{-j a1-}k a0,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a3,k a0,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a1,j a0,k a3,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes2(a,i a1,j a0{-k a2;l a3-})
    _  -> case cmp a1 a2 of
      GT -> case cmp a0 a2 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a2 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a2,k a0,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a3,k a0,l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a2,j a0,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes3(a,i a2,j a0,k a1{-l a3-})
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,i a3,j a0,{-k a2-}l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a3,{-k a2-}l a1)
          _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
            GT -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a3,l a1)
            _  -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0-}j a2,k a1{-l a3-})
      _  -> case cmp a1 a3 of
        GT -> case cmp a0 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes4(a,i a3,j a0,k a1,l a2)
          _  -> vec_writes3(a,{-i a0-}j a3,k a1,l a2)
        _  -> case cmp a2 a3 of
          GT -> vec_writes2(a,{-i a0;j a1-}k a3,l a2)
          _  -> return () {-i a0;j a1;k a2;l a3-}
{-# INLINABLE vao_sort4ByIndex #-}

  => BSB.Builder -- ^ prefix

  -> BSB.Builder -- ^ postfix
  -> (a -> BSB.Builder) -- ^ show function
  -> v a -> BSB.Builder

  = prefix <> VG.foldr
    (\ a rest !prefx -> prefx <> (showFct a <> rest separator))
    (const postfix) vec mempty

data RangeTree = RangeTree {
	startpoint :: Set.Set Int,
	endpoint :: Set.Set Int
} deriving (Show)

emptyTree :: RangeTree
emptyTree = RangeTree Set.empty Set.empty

null :: RangeTree -> Bool
null tree = Set.null $ startpoint tree

length :: RangeTree -> Int
length t = max 0 length'
	where
		length' = ep - sp + 1
		sp = Set.findMax $ startpoint t
		ep = Set.findMin $ endpoint t

insert :: (Int, Int) -> RangeTree -> RangeTree
insert (l, r) tree = RangeTree newSp newEp
	where
		newSp = Set.insert l $ startpoint tree
		newEp = Set.insert r $ endpoint tree

delete ::  (Int, Int) -> RangeTree -> RangeTree
delete (l, r) tree = RangeTree newSp newEp
	where
		newSp = Set.delete l $ startpoint tree
		newEp = Set.delete r $ endpoint tree

fromList :: [(Int, Int)] -> RangeTree
fromList = foldr Main.insert emptyTree

move :: (Int, Int) -> Writer (DList Int) (RangeTree, RangeTree) -> Writer (DList Int) (RangeTree, RangeTree)
move (l, r) trees = do
	(tree1, tree2) <- trees
	let newTree1 = delete (l, r) tree1
	let newTree2 = insert (l, r) tree2
	when (not (Main.null newTree1) && not (Main.null newTree2)) $ do
		tell $ dListSingleton $ Main.length newTree1 + Main.length newTree2
		return ()
	return (newTree1, newTree2)

;;; Treap with explicit key
;;; Virtually it works like std::map, std::multiset, or java.util.TreeMap.
;;;


;; Tips to use this structure as a multiset: Just define OP as (defun op (x y)
;; (+ x y)) and insert each element by (treap-ensure-key <treap> <key> 1
;; :if-exists #'1+) instead of TREAP-INSERT.

(declaim (inline op))
(defun op (x y)
  "Is the operator comprising a monoid"
  (declare (uint32 x y))
  (max x y))

(defconstant +op-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. OP")

(declaim (inline updater-op))
(defun updater-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to compute and update LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

(defconstant +updater-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. UPDATER-OP")

(declaim (inline modifier-op))
(defun modifier-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to update ACCUMULATOR based on LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

;; Treap with explicit key
(defstruct (treap (:constructor %make-treap (key value &key left right (accumulator value) lazy))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %treap-))
  (key 0 :type fixnum)
  (value +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (lazy +updater-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (left nil :type (or null treap))
  (right nil :type (or null treap)))

(declaim (inline treap-accumulator))
(defun treap-accumulator (treap)
  (declare ((or null treap) treap))
  (if (null treap)
      +op-identity+
      (%treap-accumulator treap)))

(declaim (inline update-accumulator))
(defun update-accumulator (treap)
  (declare (treap treap))
  (setf (%treap-accumulator treap)
        (if (%treap-left treap)
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (let ((mid-res (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                                   (%treap-value treap))))
                  (op mid-res (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))))
                (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                    (%treap-value treap)))
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (op (%treap-value treap)
                    (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap)))
                (%treap-value treap)))))

(declaim (inline force-up))
(defun force-up (treap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (update-accumulator treap))

(declaim (inline force-down))
(defun force-down (treap)
  "Propagates down the information to children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (unless (eql +updater-identity+ (%treap-lazy treap))
    (when (%treap-left treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (when (%treap-right treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (setf (%treap-value treap)
          (modifier-op (%treap-value treap)
                       (%treap-lazy treap)))
    (setf (%treap-lazy treap) +updater-identity+)))

(defun treap-bisect-left (treap key)
  "Returns the smallest key equal to or larger than KEY and the assigned
value. Returns NIL if KEY is larger than any keys in TREAP."
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum key)
           ((or null treap) treap))
  (labels ((recur (treap)
             (unless treap (return-from recur nil))
             (force-down treap)
             (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
                 (recur (%treap-right treap))
                 (or (recur (%treap-left treap))
                     treap))))
    (let ((result (recur treap)))
      (if result
          (values (%treap-key result) (%treap-value result))
          (values nil nil)))))

;; Reference: https://cp-algorithms.com/data_structures/treap.html
;; TODO: take a sorted list as the argument
(defun make-treap (sorted-vector)
  "Makes a treap using each key of the given SORTED-VECTOR in O(n). Note that
this function doesn't check if the SORTED-VECTOR is actually sorted w.r.t. your
intended order. The values are filled with the identity element."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) sorted-vector))
  (labels ((build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-treap (aref sorted-vector mid)
                                           +op-identity+)))
                   (setf (%treap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%treap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   node))))
    (build 0 (length sorted-vector))))

(defconstant +pos-inf+ most-positive-fixnum)
(defconstant +neg-inf+ most-negative-fixnum)

(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,
RIGHT). If LEFT [RIGHT] is not given, it is assumed to be -inf [+inf]."
  (declare #.OPT)
  (setq left (or left +neg-inf+)
        right (or right +pos-inf+))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (unless treap
               (return-from recur +op-identity+))
             (force-down treap)
             (prog1
                 (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                     (%treap-accumulator treap)
                     (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                       (if (<= l key)
                           (if (< key r)
                               (op (op (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                                       (%treap-value treap))
                                   (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                           (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))
  (assert (not (< right left)))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (when treap
               (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                   (progn
                     (setf (%treap-lazy treap)
                           (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap) x))
                     (force-down treap))
                   (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                     (force-down treap)
                     (if (<= l key)
                         (if (< key r)
                             (progn
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                               (setf (%treap-value treap)
                                     (modifier-op (%treap-value treap) x))
                               (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                             (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                         (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-range-bisect-left (treap value)
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum value))
  (labels
      ((recur (treap prev-sum)
         (declare (fixnum prev-sum))
         (unless treap
           (return-from recur +pos-inf+))
         (force-down treap)
         (let ((sum prev-sum))
           (prog1
               (cond ((>= (setq sum (op sum (treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))))
                          value)
                      (if (%treap-left treap)
                          (recur (%treap-left treap) prev-sum)
                          (%treap-key treap)))
                     ((>= (setq sum (op sum (%treap-value treap)))
                          value)
                      (%treap-key treap))
                     (t
                      (recur (%treap-right treap) sum)))
             (force-up treap)))))
    (recur treap +op-identity+)))

(defun solve (n ls rs ords seq)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint31 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ls rs seq ords))
  (let ((inf (reduce #'max seq))
        (treap1 (make-treap seq))
        (treap2 (make-treap seq))
        (res 0))
    (declare (uint32 inf res))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (aref ls i))
            (r (aref rs i)))
        (treap-update treap2 1 l r)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let* ((ord (aref ords i))
             (required1 i)
             (required2 (- n i))
             (l (aref ls ord))
             (r (aref rs ord))
             (max1 (treap-query treap1))
             (max2 (treap-query treap2)))
        (declare (uint32 required1 required2 max1 max2))
        (when (and (= required1 max1) (= required2 max2))
          (let* ((max1l (treap-range-bisect-left treap1 max1))
                 (max1r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max1l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap1 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (the uint32 (treap-query treap1 :left mid)) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2l (treap-range-bisect-left treap2 max2))
                 (max2r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max2l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap2 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (the uint32 (treap-query treap2 :left mid)) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (new-score (+ (- max1r max1l) (- max2r max2l))))
            (declare (uint32 max1l max1r max2l max2r))
            (unless (zerop i)
              (setq res (max res new-score)))))
        (treap-update treap1 1 l r)
        (treap-update treap2 -1 l r)))
    res))

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT
           (inline sort))
  (let* ((n (read))
         (ls (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (rs (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (ords (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (seq (make-array (+ n n) :element-type 'uint31)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (- (read-fixnum) 1))
            (r (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref ls i) l
              (aref rs i) r
              (aref ords i) i
              (aref seq i) l
              (aref seq (+ i n)) r)))
    (setq seq (sort seq #'<)
          ords (sort ords (lambda (x y) (< (aref rs x) (aref rs y)))))
    (setq seq (delete-adjacent-duplicates seq))
    (let ((cand (solve n ls rs ords seq)))
      (let ((idx 0)
            (l 0)
            (r 1000000000))
        (declare (uint32 idx l r))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (when (>= (- (aref rs i) (aref ls i))
                    (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx)))
            (setq idx i)))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (unless (= idx i)
            (setq l (max l (aref ls i))
                  r (min r (aref rs i)))))
        (let ((cand2 (+ (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx))
                        (max 0 (- r l)))))
          (println (max cand cand2)))))))

(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,

        right (or right +pos-inf+))

             (declare (fixnum l r))

               (return-from recur +op-identity+))
             (force-down treap)
             (prog1
                 (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                     (%treap-accumulator treap)
                     (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                       (if (<= l key)
                           (if (< key r)
                               (op (op (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                                       (%treap-value treap))
                                   (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                           (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))

  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (when treap
               (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                   (progn
                     (setf (%treap-lazy treap)
                           (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap) x))
                     (force-down treap))
                   (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                     (force-down treap)
                     (if (<= l key)
                         (if (< key r)
                             (progn
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                               (setf (%treap-value treap)
                                     (modifier-op (%treap-value treap) x))
                               (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                             (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                         (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

         (force-down treap)

(defun solve (n ls rs ords seq)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint31 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ls rs seq ords))
  (let ((inf (reduce #'max seq))
        (treap1 (make-treap seq))
        (treap2 (make-treap seq))
        (res 0))
    (declare (uint32 inf res))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (aref ls i))
            (r (aref rs i)))
        (treap-update treap2 1 l r)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let* ((ord (aref ords i))
             (required1 i)
             (required2 (- n i))
             (l (aref ls ord))
             (r (aref rs ord))
             (max1 (treap-query treap1))
             (max2 (treap-query treap2)))
        (declare (uint32 required1 required2 max1 max2))
        (unless (zerop i)
          (when (and (= required1 max1) (= required2 max2))
            (let* ((max1l (treap-range-bisect treap1 max1))
                   (max1r (treap-bisect-left treap1 (+ 1 (treap-range-bisect-from-end treap1 max1))))
                   (max2l (treap-range-bisect treap2 max2))
                   (max2r (treap-bisect-left treap2 (+ 1 (treap-range-bisect-from-end treap2 max2))))
                   (new-score (+ (- max1r max1l) (- max2r max2l))))
              (declare (uint32 max1l max1r max2l max2r))
              (setq res (max res new-score)))))
        (treap-update treap1 1 l r)
        (treap-update treap2 -1 l r)))
    res))

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT
           (inline sort))
  (let* ((n (read))
         (ls (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (rs (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (ords (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (seq (make-array (+ n n) :element-type 'uint31)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (- (read-fixnum) 1))
            (r (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref ls i) l
              (aref rs i) r
              (aref ords i) i
              (aref seq i) l
              (aref seq (+ i n)) r)))
    (setq seq (sort seq #'<)
          ords (sort ords (lambda (x y) (< (aref rs x) (aref rs y)))))
    (setq seq (delete-adjacent-duplicates seq))
    (let ((cand (solve n ls rs ords seq)))
      (let ((idx 0)
            (l 0)
            (r 1000000000))
        (declare (uint32 idx l r))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (when (>= (- (aref rs i) (aref ls i))
                    (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx)))
            (setq idx i)))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (unless (= idx i)
            (setq l (max l (aref ls i))
                  r (min r (aref rs i)))))
        (let ((cand2 (+ (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx))
                        (max 0 (- r l)))))
          (println (max cand cand2)))))))

              (values left treap))))))

(defun treap-merge (left right)
  "Destructively concatenates two treaps. Assumes that all keys of LEFT are
smaller (or larger, depending on the order) than those of RIGHT."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null treap) left right))
  (cond ((null left) (when right (force-down right) (force-up right)) right)
        ((null right) (when left (force-down left) (force-up left)) left)
        (t (force-down left)
           (force-down right)
         (if (> (%treap-priority left) (%treap-priority right))
             (progn
               (setf (%treap-right left)
                     (treap-merge (%treap-right left) right))
               (force-up left)
               left)
             (progn
               (setf (%treap-left right)
                     (treap-merge left (%treap-left right)))
               (force-up right)
               right)))))

;; Reference: https://cp-algorithms.com/data_structures/treap.html
;; TODO: take a sorted list as the argument
(defun make-treap (sorted-vector)
  "Makes a treap using each key of the given SORTED-VECTOR in O(n). Note that
this function doesn't check if the SORTED-VECTOR is actually sorted w.r.t. your
intended order. The values are filled with the identity element."
  (declare #.OPT
           (vector sorted-vector))
  (labels ((heapify (top)
             (when top
               (let ((prioritized-node top))
                 (when (and (%treap-left top)
                            (> (%treap-priority (%treap-left top))
                               (%treap-priority prioritized-node)))
                   (setq prioritized-node (%treap-left top)))
                 (when (and (%treap-right top)
                            (> (%treap-priority (%treap-right top))
                               (%treap-priority prioritized-node)))
                   (setq prioritized-node (%treap-right top)))
                 (unless (eql prioritized-node top)
                   (rotatef (%treap-priority prioritized-node)
                            (%treap-priority top))
                   (heapify prioritized-node)))))
           (build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-treap (aref sorted-vector mid)
                                           (random most-positive-fixnum)
                                           +op-identity+)))
                   (setf (%treap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%treap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   (heapify node)
                   node))))
    (build 0 (length sorted-vector))))

;; FIXME: might be problematic when two priorities collide.
(declaim (inline treap-query))
(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,
RIGHT). If LEFT [RIGHT] is not given, it is assumed to be -inf [+inf]."
  (if (null left)
      (if (null right)
          (treap-accumulator treap)
          (multiple-value-bind (treap-0-r treap-r-n)
              (treap-split treap right)
            (prog1 (treap-accumulator treap-0-r)
              (treap-merge treap-0-r treap-r-n))))
      (if (null right)
          (multiple-value-bind (treap-0-l treap-l-n)
              (treap-split treap left)
            (prog1 (treap-accumulator treap-l-n)
              (treap-merge treap-0-l treap-l-n)))
          (progn
            (assert (not (< right left)))
            (multiple-value-bind (treap-0-l treap-l-n)
                (treap-split treap left)
              (multiple-value-bind (treap-l-r treap-r-n)
                  (treap-split treap-l-n right)
                (prog1 (treap-accumulator treap-l-r)
                  (treap-merge treap-0-l (treap-merge treap-l-r treap-r-n)))))))))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))
  (assert (not (< right left)))
  (multiple-value-bind (treap-0-l treap-l-n)
      (treap-split treap left)
    (multiple-value-bind (treap-l-r treap-r-n)
        (treap-split treap-l-n right)
      (when treap-l-r
        (setf (%treap-lazy treap-l-r)
              (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap-l-r) x)))
      (treap-merge treap-0-l (treap-merge treap-l-r treap-r-n)))))

(defun solve (n ls rs lrs seq)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint31 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ls rs seq)
           ((simple-array (cons uint31 uint31) (*)) lrs))
  (let ((inf (reduce #'max seq))
        (treap1 (make-treap seq))
        (treap2 (make-treap seq))
        (res 0))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (aref ls i))
            (r (aref rs i)))
        (dbg l r)
        (treap-update treap2 1 l r)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let* ((lr (aref lrs i))
             (required1 i)
             (required2 (- n i))
             (l (car lr))
             (r (cdr lr))
             (max1 (treap-query treap1))
             (max2 (treap-query treap2)))
        (when (and (= required1 max1) (= required2 max2))
          (let* ((max1l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (treap-query treap1 :right mid) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max1r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap1 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (treap-query treap1 :left mid) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (treap-query treap2 :right mid) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap2 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (treap-query treap2 :left mid) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (new-score (+ (- max1r max1l) (- max2r max2l))))
            (unless (zerop i)
              (setq res (max res new-score)))))
        (treap-update treap1 1 l r)
        (treap-update treap2 -1 l r)))
    res))

(declaim (inline op))
(defun op (x y)

  (declare (uint32 x y))
  (max x y))

(defconstant +op-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. OP")

(declaim (inline updater-op))
(defun updater-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to compute and update LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

(defconstant +updater-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. UPDATER-OP")

(declaim (inline modifier-op))
(defun modifier-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to update ACCUMULATOR based on LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

;; Treap with explicit key
(defstruct (treap (:constructor %make-treap (key value &key left right (accumulator value) lazy))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %treap-))
  (key 0 :type fixnum)
  (value +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (lazy +updater-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (left nil :type (or null treap))
  (right nil :type (or null treap)))

(declaim (inline treap-accumulator))
(defun treap-accumulator (treap)
  (declare ((or null treap) treap))
  (if (null treap)
      +op-identity+
      (%treap-accumulator treap)))

(declaim (inline update-accumulator))
(defun update-accumulator (treap)
  (declare (treap treap))
  (setf (%treap-accumulator treap)
        (if (%treap-left treap)
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (let ((mid-res (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                                   (%treap-value treap))))
                  (op mid-res (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))))
                (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                    (%treap-value treap)))
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (op (%treap-value treap)
                    (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap)))
                (%treap-value treap)))))

(declaim (inline force-up))
(defun force-up (treap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (update-accumulator treap))

(declaim (inline force-down))
(defun force-down (treap)
  "Propagates down the information to children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (unless (eql +updater-identity+ (%treap-lazy treap))
    (when (%treap-left treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (when (%treap-right treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (setf (%treap-value treap)
          (modifier-op (%treap-value treap)
                       (%treap-lazy treap)))
    (setf (%treap-lazy treap) +updater-identity+)))

(defun treap-bisect-left (treap key)
  "Returns the smallest key equal to or larger than KEY and the assigned
value. Returns NIL if KEY is larger than any keys in TREAP."
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum key)
           ((or null treap) treap))
  (labels ((recur (treap)
             (unless treap (return-from recur nil))
             (force-down treap)
             (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
                 (recur (%treap-right treap))
                 (or (recur (%treap-left treap))
                     treap))))
    (let ((result (recur treap)))
      (if result
          (values (%treap-key result) (%treap-value result))
          (values nil nil)))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (or null treap) (or null treap) &optional)) treap-split))
(defun treap-split (treap key)
  "Destructively splits the TREAP with reference to KEY and returns two treaps,
the smaller sub-treap (< KEY) and the larger one (>= KEY)."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null treap) treap)
           (uint32 key))
  (if (null treap)
      (values nil nil)
      (progn
        (force-down treap)
        (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
            (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                (treap-split (%treap-right treap) key)
              (setf (%treap-right treap) left)
              (force-up treap)
              (values treap right))
            (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                (treap-split (%treap-left treap) key)
              (setf (%treap-left treap) right)
              (force-up treap)
              (values left treap))))))

;; Reference: https://cp-algorithms.com/data_structures/treap.html
;; TODO: take a sorted list as the argument
(defun make-treap (sorted-vector)
  "Makes a treap using each key of the given SORTED-VECTOR in O(n). Note that
this function doesn't check if the SORTED-VECTOR is actually sorted w.r.t. your
intended order. The values are filled with the identity element."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) sorted-vector))
  (labels ((build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-treap (aref sorted-vector mid)
                                           +op-identity+)))
                   (setf (%treap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%treap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   node))))
    (build 0 (length sorted-vector))))

(defconstant +pos-inf+ most-positive-fixnum)
(defconstant +neg-inf+ most-negative-fixnum)

(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,
RIGHT). If LEFT [RIGHT] is not given, it is assumed to be -inf [+inf]."
  (declare #.OPT)
  (setq left (or left +neg-inf+)
        right (or right +pos-inf+))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (unless treap
               (return-from recur +op-identity+))
             (force-down treap)
             (prog1
                 (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                     (%treap-accumulator treap)
                     (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                       (if (<= l key)
                           (if (< key r)
                               (op (op (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                                       (%treap-value treap))
                                   (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                           (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))
  (assert (not (< right left)))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (when treap
               (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                   (progn
                     (setf (%treap-lazy treap)
                           (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap) x))
                     (force-down treap))
                   (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                     (force-down treap)
                     (if (<= l key)
                         (if (< key r)
                             (progn
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                               (setf (%treap-value treap)
                                     (modifier-op (%treap-value treap) x))
                               (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                             (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                         (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun solve (n ls rs ords seq)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint31 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ls rs seq ords))
  (let ((inf (reduce #'max seq))
        (treap1 (make-treap seq))
        (treap2 (make-treap seq))
        (res 0))
    (declare (uint32 inf res))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (aref ls i))
            (r (aref rs i)))
        (treap-update treap2 1 l r)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let* ((ord (aref ords i))
             (required1 i)
             (required2 (- n i))
             (l (aref ls ord))
             (r (aref rs ord))
             (max1 (treap-query treap1))
             (max2 (treap-query treap2)))
        (declare (uint32 required1 required2 max1 max2))
        (when (and (= required1 max1) (= required2 max2))
          (let* ((max1l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (the uint32 (treap-query treap1 :right mid)) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max1r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max1l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap1 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (the uint32 (treap-query treap1 :left mid)) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (the uint32 (treap-query treap2 :right mid)) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max2l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap2 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (the uint32 (treap-query treap2 :left mid)) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (new-score (+ (- max1r max1l) (- max2r max2l))))
            (declare (uint32 max1l max1r max2l max2r))
            (unless (zerop i)
              (setq res (max res new-score)))))
        (treap-update treap1 1 l r)
        (treap-update treap2 -1 l r)))
    res))

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT
           (inline sort))
  (let* ((n (read))
         (ls (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (rs (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (ords (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (seq (make-array (+ n n) :element-type 'uint31)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (- (read-fixnum) 1))
            (r (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref ls i) l
              (aref rs i) r
              (aref ords i) i
              (aref seq i) l
              (aref seq (+ i n)) r)))
    (setq seq (sort seq #'<)
          ords (sort ords (lambda (x y) (< (aref rs x) (aref rs y)))))
    (setq seq (delete-adjacent-duplicates seq))
    (let ((cand (solve n ls rs ords seq)))
      (let ((idx 0)
            (l 0)
            (r 1000000000))
        (declare (uint32 idx l r))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (when (>= (- (aref rs i) (aref ls i))
                    (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx)))
            (setq idx i)))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (unless (= idx i)
            (setq l (max l (aref ls i))
                  r (min r (aref rs i)))))
        (let ((cand2 (+ (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx))
                        (max 0 (- r l)))))
          (println (max cand cand2)))))))

     ,@(mapcar (lambda (b) `(deftype ,(intern (format nil "UINT~A" b)) () '(unsigned-byte ,b))) bits)

(defun delete-adjacent-duplicates (seq &key (test #'eql))
  "Destructively deletes adjacent duplicates of SEQ: e.g. #(1 1 1 2 2 1 3) ->
#(1 2 1 3)"
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) seq)
           (function test))
  (if (zerop (length seq))
         seq
         (let ((prev (aref seq 0))
               (end 1))
           (loop for pos from 1 below (length seq)
                 unless (funcall test prev (aref seq pos))
                 do (setf prev (aref seq pos)
                          (aref seq end) (aref seq pos)
                          end (+ 1 end)))
           ;; KLUDGE: Resorting to ADJUST-ARRAY is maybe substandard. 
           (adjust-array seq end))))

                     #+swank (char-code (read-char in nil #\Nul))

;;; Treap with explicit key
;;; Virtually it works like std::map, std::multiset, or java.util.TreeMap.
;;;


;; Tips to use this structure as a multiset: Just define OP as (defun op (x y)
;; (+ x y)) and insert each element by (treap-ensure-key <treap> <key> 1
;; :if-exists #'1+) instead of TREAP-INSERT.

(declaim (inline op))
(defun op (x y)
  "Is the operator comprising a monoid"
  (declare (uint32 x y))
  (max x y))

(defconstant +op-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. OP")

(declaim (inline updater-op))
(defun updater-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to compute and update LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

(defconstant +updater-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. UPDATER-OP")

(declaim (inline modifier-op))
(defun modifier-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to update ACCUMULATOR based on LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

;; Treap with explicit key
(defstruct (treap (:constructor %make-treap (key value &key left right (accumulator value) lazy))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %treap-))
  (key 0 :type fixnum)
  (value +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (lazy +updater-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (left nil :type (or null treap))
  (right nil :type (or null treap)))

(declaim (inline treap-accumulator))
(defun treap-accumulator (treap)
  (declare ((or null treap) treap))
  (if (null treap)
      +op-identity+
      (%treap-accumulator treap)))

(declaim (inline update-accumulator))
(defun update-accumulator (treap)
  (declare (treap treap))
  (setf (%treap-accumulator treap)
        (if (%treap-left treap)
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (let ((mid-res (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                                   (%treap-value treap))))
                  (op mid-res (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))))
                (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                    (%treap-value treap)))
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (op (%treap-value treap)
                    (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap)))
                (%treap-value treap)))))

(declaim (inline force-up))
(defun force-up (treap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (update-accumulator treap))

(declaim (inline force-down))
(defun force-down (treap)
  "Propagates down the information to children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (unless (eql +updater-identity+ (%treap-lazy treap))
    (when (%treap-left treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (when (%treap-right treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (setf (%treap-value treap)
          (modifier-op (%treap-value treap)
                       (%treap-lazy treap)))
    (setf (%treap-lazy treap) +updater-identity+)))

(defun treap-bisect-left (treap key)
  "Returns the smallest key equal to or larger than KEY and the assigned
value. Returns NIL if KEY is larger than any keys in TREAP."
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum key)
           ((or null treap) treap))
  (labels ((recur (treap)
             (unless treap (return-from recur nil))
             (force-down treap)
             (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
                 (recur (%treap-right treap))
                 (or (recur (%treap-left treap))
                     treap))))
    (let ((result (recur treap)))
      (if result
          (values (%treap-key result) (%treap-value result))
          (values nil nil)))))

;; Reference: https://cp-algorithms.com/data_structures/treap.html
;; TODO: take a sorted list as the argument
(defun make-treap (sorted-vector)
  "Makes a treap using each key of the given SORTED-VECTOR in O(n). Note that
this function doesn't check if the SORTED-VECTOR is actually sorted w.r.t. your
intended order. The values are filled with the identity element."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) sorted-vector))
  (labels ((build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-treap (aref sorted-vector mid)
                                           +op-identity+)))
                   (setf (%treap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%treap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   node))))
    (build 0 (length sorted-vector))))

(defconstant +pos-inf+ most-positive-fixnum)
(defconstant +neg-inf+ most-negative-fixnum)

(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,
RIGHT). If LEFT [RIGHT] is not given, it is assumed to be -inf [+inf]."
  (declare #.OPT)
  (setq left (or left +neg-inf+)
        right (or right +pos-inf+))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (unless treap
               (return-from recur +op-identity+))
             (force-down treap)
             (prog1
                 (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                     (%treap-accumulator treap)
                     (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                       (if (<= l key)
                           (if (< key r)
                               (op (op (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                                       (%treap-value treap))
                                   (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                           (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))
  (assert (not (< right left)))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (when treap
               (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                   (progn
                     (setf (%treap-lazy treap)
                           (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap) x))
                     (force-down treap))
                   (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                     (force-down treap)
                     (if (<= l key)
                         (if (< key r)
                             (progn
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                               (setf (%treap-value treap)
                                     (modifier-op (%treap-value treap) x))
                               (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                             (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                         (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-range-bisect-left (treap value)
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum value))
  (labels
      ((recur (treap prev-sum)
         (declare (fixnum prev-sum))
         (unless treap
           (return-from recur +pos-inf+))
         (force-down treap)
         (let ((sum prev-sum))
           (prog1
               (cond ((>= (setq sum (op sum (treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))))
                          value)
                      (if (%treap-left treap)
                          (recur (%treap-left treap) prev-sum)
                          (%treap-key treap)))
                     ((>= (setq sum (op sum (%treap-value treap)))
                          value)
                      (%treap-key treap))
                     (t
                      (recur (%treap-right treap) sum)))
             (force-up treap)))))
    (recur treap +op-identity+)))

  `(progn
     ,@(mapcar (lambda (b) `(deftype ,(intern (format nil "UINT~A" b)) () '(unsigned-byte ,b))) bits)

(defun delete-adjacent-duplicates (seq &key (test #'eql))
  "Destructively deletes adjacent duplicates of SEQ: e.g. #(1 1 1 2 2 1 3) ->
#(1 2 1 3)"
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) seq)
           (function test))
  (if (zerop (length seq))
         seq
         (let ((prev (aref seq 0))
               (end 1))
           (loop for pos from 1 below (length seq)
                 unless (funcall test prev (aref seq pos))
                 do (setf prev (aref seq pos)
                          (aref seq end) (aref seq pos)
                          end (+ 1 end)))
           ;; KLUDGE: Resorting to ADJUST-ARRAY is maybe substandard. 
           (adjust-array seq end))))

;; Tips to use this structure as a multiset: Just define OP as (defun op (x y)
;; (+ x y)) and insert each element by (treap-ensure-key <treap> <key> 1
;; :if-exists #'1+) instead of TREAP-INSERT.

(declaim (inline op))
(defun op (x y)
  "Is the operator comprising a monoid"
  (declare (uint32 x y))
  (max x y))

(defconstant +op-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. OP")

(declaim (inline updater-op))
(defun updater-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to compute and update LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

(defconstant +updater-identity+ 0
  "identity element w.r.t. UPDATER-OP")

(declaim (inline modifier-op))
(defun modifier-op (a b)
  "Is the operator to update ACCUMULATOR based on LAZY value."
  (declare (int32 a b))
  (+ a b))

;; Treap with explicit key
(defstruct (treap (:constructor %make-treap (key priority value &key left right (accumulator value) lazy))
                  (:copier nil)
                  (:conc-name %treap-))
  (key 0 :type fixnum)
  (value +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (accumulator +op-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (lazy +updater-identity+ :type fixnum)
  (priority 0 :type (integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum))
  (left nil :type (or null treap))
  (right nil :type (or null treap)))

(declaim (inline treap-accumulator))
(defun treap-accumulator (treap)
  (declare ((or null treap) treap))
  (if (null treap)
      +op-identity+
      (%treap-accumulator treap)))

(declaim (inline update-accumulator))
(defun update-accumulator (treap)
  (declare (treap treap))
  (setf (%treap-accumulator treap)
        (if (%treap-left treap)
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (let ((mid-res (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                                   (%treap-value treap))))
                  (declare (dynamic-extent mid-res))
                  (op mid-res (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))))
                (op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                    (%treap-value treap)))
            (if (%treap-right treap)
                (op (%treap-value treap)
                    (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap)))
                (%treap-value treap)))))

(declaim (inline force-up))
(defun force-up (treap)
  "Propagates up the information from children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (update-accumulator treap))

(declaim (inline force-down))
(defun force-down (treap)
  "Propagates down the information to children."
  (declare (treap treap))
  (unless (eql +updater-identity+ (%treap-lazy treap))
    (when (%treap-left treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-left treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-left treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (when (%treap-right treap)
      (setf (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
            (updater-op (%treap-lazy (%treap-right treap))
                        (%treap-lazy treap)))
      (setf (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
            (modifier-op (%treap-accumulator (%treap-right treap))
                         (%treap-lazy treap))))
    (setf (%treap-value treap)
          (modifier-op (%treap-value treap)
                       (%treap-lazy treap)))
    (setf (%treap-lazy treap) +updater-identity+)))

(defun treap-bisect-left (treap key)
  "Returns the smallest key equal to or larger than KEY and the assigned
value. Returns NIL if KEY is larger than any keys in TREAP."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null treap) treap))
  (labels ((recur (treap)
             (unless treap (return-from recur nil))
             (force-down treap)
             (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
                 (recur (%treap-right treap))
                 (or (recur (%treap-left treap))
                     treap))))
    (let ((result (recur treap)))
      (if result
          (values (%treap-key result) (%treap-value result))
          (values nil nil)))))

(declaim (ftype (function * (values (or null treap) (or null treap) &optional)) treap-split))
(defun treap-split (treap key)
  "Destructively splits the TREAP with reference to KEY and returns two treaps,
the smaller sub-treap (< KEY) and the larger one (>= KEY)."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null treap) treap)
           (uint32 key))
  (if (null treap)
      (values nil nil)
      (progn
        (force-down treap)
        (if (< (%treap-key treap) key)
            (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                (treap-split (%treap-right treap) key)
              (setf (%treap-right treap) left)
              (force-up treap)
              (values treap right))
            (multiple-value-bind (left right)
                (treap-split (%treap-left treap) key)
              (setf (%treap-left treap) right)
              (force-up treap)
              (values left treap))))))

(defun treap-merge (left right)
  "Destructively concatenates two treaps. Assumes that all keys of LEFT are
smaller (or larger, depending on the order) than those of RIGHT."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((or null treap) left right))
  (cond ((null left) (when right (force-down right) (force-up right)) right)
        ((null right) (when left (force-down left) (force-up left)) left)
        (t (force-down left)
           (force-down right)
         (if (> (%treap-priority left) (%treap-priority right))
             (progn
               (setf (%treap-right left)
                     (treap-merge (%treap-right left) right))
               (force-up left)
               left)
             (progn
               (setf (%treap-left right)
                     (treap-merge left (%treap-left right)))
               (force-up right)
               right)))))

;; Reference: https://cp-algorithms.com/data_structures/treap.html
;; TODO: take a sorted list as the argument
(defun make-treap (sorted-vector)
  "Makes a treap using each key of the given SORTED-VECTOR in O(n). Note that
this function doesn't check if the SORTED-VECTOR is actually sorted w.r.t. your
intended order. The values are filled with the identity element."
  (declare #.OPT
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) sorted-vector))
  (labels ((heapify (top)
             (when top
               (let ((prioritized-node top))
                 (when (and (%treap-left top)
                            (> (%treap-priority (%treap-left top))
                               (%treap-priority prioritized-node)))
                   (setq prioritized-node (%treap-left top)))
                 (when (and (%treap-right top)
                            (> (%treap-priority (%treap-right top))
                               (%treap-priority prioritized-node)))
                   (setq prioritized-node (%treap-right top)))
                 (unless (eql prioritized-node top)
                   (rotatef (%treap-priority prioritized-node)
                            (%treap-priority top))
                   (heapify prioritized-node)))))
           (build (l r)
             (declare ((integer 0 #.most-positive-fixnum) l r))
             (if (= l r)
                 nil
                 (let* ((mid (ash (+ l r) -1))
                        (node (%make-treap (aref sorted-vector mid)
                                           (random most-positive-fixnum)
                                           +op-identity+)))
                   (setf (%treap-left node) (build l mid))
                   (setf (%treap-right node) (build (+ mid 1) r))
                   (heapify node)
                   node))))
    (build 0 (length sorted-vector))))

(defconstant +pos-inf+ most-positive-fixnum)
(defconstant +neg-inf+ most-negative-fixnum)

(defun treap-query (treap &key left right)
  "Queries the sum of the half-open interval specified by the keys: [LEFT,
RIGHT). If LEFT [RIGHT] is not given, it is assumed to be -inf [+inf]."
  (declare #.OPT)
  (setq left (or left +neg-inf+)
        right (or right +pos-inf+))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (unless treap
               (return-from recur +op-identity+))
             (force-down treap)
             (prog1
                 (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                     (%treap-accumulator treap)
                     (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                       (if (<= l key)
                           (if (< key r)
                               (funcall #'op
                                        (funcall #'op
                                                 (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                                                 (%treap-value treap))
                                        (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                           (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun treap-update (treap x left right)
  "Updates TREAP[KEY] := (OP TREAP[KEY] X) for all KEY in [l, r)"
  (declare #.OPT
           (fixnum left right))
  (assert (not (< right left)))
  (labels ((recur (treap l r)
             (declare (fixnum l r))
             (when treap
               (if (and (= l +neg-inf+) (= r +pos-inf+))
                   (progn
                     (setf (%treap-lazy treap)
                           (updater-op (%treap-lazy treap) x))
                     (force-down treap))
                   (let ((key (%treap-key treap)))
                     (force-down treap)
                     (if (<= l key)
                         (if (< key r)
                             (progn
                               (recur (%treap-left treap) l +pos-inf+)
                               (setf (%treap-value treap)
                                     (modifier-op (%treap-value treap) x))
                               (recur (%treap-right treap) +neg-inf+ r))
                             (recur (%treap-left treap) l r))
                         (recur (%treap-right treap) l r))))
               (force-up treap))))
    (recur treap left right)))

(defun solve (n ls rs lrs seq)
  (declare #.OPT
           (uint31 n)
           ((simple-array uint31 (*)) ls rs seq)
           ((simple-array (cons uint31 uint31) (*)) lrs))
  (let ((inf (reduce #'max seq))
        (treap1 (make-treap seq))
        (treap2 (make-treap seq))
        (res 0))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (aref ls i))
            (r (aref rs i)))
        (dbg l r)
        (treap-update treap2 1 l r)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let* ((lr (aref lrs i))
             (required1 i)
             (required2 (- n i))
             (l (car lr))
             (r (cdr lr))
             (max1 (treap-query treap1))
             (max2 (treap-query treap2)))
        (when (and (= required1 max1) (= required2 max2))
          (let* ((max1l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (treap-query treap1 :right mid) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max1r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max1l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap1 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (treap-query treap1 :left mid) max1)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2l (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng 0) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (- ok 1)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (= (treap-query treap2 :right mid) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (max2r (sb-int:named-let bisect ((ng max2l) (ok inf))
                          (declare (uint32 ng ok))
                          (if (<= (- ok ng) 1)
                              (treap-bisect-left treap2 ok)
                              (let ((mid (ash (+ ng ok) -1)))
                                (if (< (treap-query treap2 :left mid) max2)
                                    (bisect ng mid)
                                    (bisect mid ok))))))
                 (new-score (+ (- max1r max1l) (- max2r max2l))))
            (unless (zerop i)
              (setq res (max res new-score)))))
        (treap-update treap1 1 l r)
        (treap-update treap2 -1 l r)))
    res))

(defun main ()
  (declare #.OPT
           (inline sort))
  (let* ((n (read))
         (ls (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (rs (make-array n :element-type 'uint31))
         (lrs (make-array n :element-type '(cons uint31 uint31)))
         (seq (make-array (+ n n) :element-type 'uint31)))
    (dotimes (i n)
      (let ((l (- (read-fixnum) 1))
            (r (read-fixnum)))
        (setf (aref ls i) l
              (aref rs i) r
              (aref lrs i) (cons l r)
              (aref seq i) l
              (aref seq (+ i n)) r)))
    (setq seq (sort seq #'<)
          lrs (sort lrs (lambda (x y) (< (the uint32 x) (the uint32 y))) :key #'cdr))
    (setq seq (delete-adjacent-duplicates seq))
    (let ((cand (solve n ls rs lrs seq)))
      (let ((idx 0)
            (l 0)
            (r 1000000000))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (when (>= (- (aref rs i) (aref ls i))
                    (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx)))
            (setq idx i)))
        (dotimes (i n)
          (unless (= idx i)
            (setq l (max l (aref ls i))
                  r (min r (aref rs i)))))
        (let ((cand2 (+ (- (aref rs idx) (aref ls idx))
                        (max 0 (- r l)))))
          (println (max cand cand2)))))))
